description: Check if an email address can receive mail before you send: syntax, whether the domain has mail servers (MX), disposable/throwaway providers (a public blocklist), role addresses like info@ or support@, free-provider detection and typo suggestions for common misspellings of big mail providers (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Returns a deliverable / risky / undeliverable verdict. Costs $0.002 per call.
name: email_verify
title: Email address verification
